changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Define action-level permissions (VIEW, UPDATE, FULL) for each role on each page
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, 'UPDATE', TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-sample-reception' AND sr.name = 'Virology Lab Technician' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );

INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, 'UPDATE', TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-sample-reception' AND sr.name = 'Virology Microbiologist' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );

INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, CASE WHEN sr.name IN ('Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator') THEN 'FULL' ELSE 'UPDATE' END, TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type IN ('virology-viral-culture', 'virology-molecular-testing', 'virology-antigen-testing', 'virology-serology-testing', 'virology-microscopy-staining') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );

INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, 'FULL', TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-quality-control' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );

INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, CASE WHEN sr.name IN ('Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator') THEN 'FULL' WHEN sr.name = 'Virology Microbiologist' THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN sr.name = 'Virology Data Manager' THEN 'VIEW' END, TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-results-analysis' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );

INSERT INTO notebook_page_permission (id, page_role_id, permission_level, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_permission_seq'), npr.id, CASE WHEN sr.name IN ('Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator') THEN 'FULL' WHEN sr.name IN ('Virology Lab Technician', 'Virology Microbiologist') THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN sr.name = 'Virology Data Manager' THEN 'VIEW' END, TRUE FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id JOIN system_role sr ON npr.role_id = sr.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-storage-documentation' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_permission npp WHERE npp.page_role_id = npr.id );
